wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Kowe bisa ngunci fitur seminggu, rong minggu, sesasi utawa selawase. Tombol krisis, bantuan kambuh, kontak telpon aman lan mbusak data ora tau dikunci.

community.noPhone: Nomer telpon ora tau ditampilake ing pesen antar kanca.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Simpen sponsor utawa kontak amanmu cedhak.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Iki tenan mbusak datamu lan ora bisa dibalekake.
safety.wipeConfirm: Aku paham yen iki tenan mbusak dataku.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Tips sifat anonim. Nomer telpon ora tau ditampilake.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Apa sing mbantu kowe ing langkah iki?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Langkah pertama rampung — sugeng rawuh mulih.
reentry.crisisStep: Simpen nomer-nomer iki saiki. Kowe uga bisa mencet "Need help now" ing ndhuwur saben layar.
reentry.resourceOnly: Mung pandhuan sumber daya — Groundwork ora nyedhiyakake iki lan ora kemitraan karo sapa wae.

steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Priksa kertas pembebasan lan batas wektu
steps.step10: Konfirmasi tanggal check-in pertama lan syarate
steps.step13: Entuk telpon, email lan internet gratis
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step27: Lamar menyang pemberi kerja kesempatan kapindho
steps.step29: Buka rekening bank lan gawe anggaran
steps.step31: Nyambung maneh karo kulawarga lan beresake tunjangan anak yen perlu
steps.step33: Gawe siji target jangka panjang lan rayakake 90 dinamu

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Pribadi dadi bawaan. Bagikake mung yen kowe milih.

venue.placeholder: Papan sementara — kamar kothak abu-abu. Ora ana foto papan asli; iki dudu papan asline.

family.help: Kulawarga mung weruh sing kokpilih kanggo dibagi.
family.defaultsOff: Saben sing dibagi dipateni dadi bawaan.

phase3.resumeHelp: Gawe resume teks prasaja saka pengalamanmu.
phase3.headline: Irah-irahan
phase3.interviewHelp: Latihan jawaban. Pelatihmu menehi nilai lan siji tips.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Mung kuthamu sing katon wong liya. Lokasi pas ora tau dibagi.
phase3.rideHelp: Njaluk tumpakan. Nomer telpon ora tau ditampilake. Ketemu ing papan umum.
phase3.partnersHelp: Grup cilik isi telu sing padha njaga.
phase3.caption: Keterangan foto
phase3.qaHelp: Takon anonim. Sing mangsuli anggota sing luwih dhisik.
phase3.merchHelp: Mung tandha kode. Ora ana ing njaba sing nerangake tegese, lan ora ana tanggal dicithak.
phase3.archiveHelp: Segel pesen kanggo awakmu dhewe. Dibukak ing dina tonggak.
phase3.matchHelp: Agenmu omongan dhisik karo agen liya. Kencan dipateni saiki. Kowe bisa weruh kenapa, njaluk perkenalan lan nyoba maneh.
phase3.datingOff: Kencan dipateni nganti ana aturan dina minimal.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Deleng kene dhisik. Opsional, level kutha wae: deleng sapa sing menyang pertemuanmu lan hubungi lewat pesen app. Ora ana telpon, ora ana lokasi pas.
phase3.groupsHelp: Grup pemulihan, dhukungan bali, iman lan komunitas miturut kutha lan wektu pertemuan. Mung data conto — dudu dhaptar asli.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Mung katon yen ora ana ing papan sing menyang pertemuanmu. Ngirim panjaluk dimoderasi ing app — level kutha wae, tanpa telpon.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Ora ana carpool sing cocog kanggo pertemuan iki, mula Butuh tumpakan ditampilake minangka cadangan.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Mung sopir disetujoni. Ping dikirim siji-siji karo jeda 2 menit; kowe konfirmasi sadurunge sabanjure.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Mung trek conto. Ora ana akun streaming. Pamuter dipateni ing modul akademi lan kursus.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Musik dipateni nalika kowe ing modul kursus.
phase3.shareWho: Saiki: mung kowe. Gawe link ngidinake sapa wae sing duwe link maca.
phase3.suggestHelp: Mung saran — ora ana sing diterbitake nganti koktambahake.
